---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an enhancement to the site, docs, or app direction
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: Bilal140202
---

**Problem to solve**
Describe the *problem*, not the implementation. Who is affected and when does it hurt?

**Proposed solution**
What you think should happen, concretely.

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches you evaluated, and why this one wins.

**Telemetry & privacy impact**
Does this require any network access or new permissions?
(If yes, explain why the same goal cannot be met offline. Features that add tracking
will be declined per CONTRIBUTING.md.)

**Scope**
- [ ] Site (this repository)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Android app direction (discussed here, implemented in the app repo)

**Checklist**
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md
- [ ] I have searched existing issues for duplicates
